verdict.rationale: The official JS SDK README links a sample that adds PSTN dial-in to Amazon Chime SDK meetings using a SIP media application, so phone callers joining a session is documented. However, the pack has no evidence of dial-out into meetings. A service-change page also says only existing customers can continue using PSTN Audio and points to migrating SIP media applications to Flows, which limits availability. Missing for 10: documented dial-out to phone callers, first-party reference docs (beyond a sample repo) for SIP/PSTN meeting join, clarity on availability for new customers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, phone callers join a session through documented SIP or PSTN dial-in and dial-out

citations.quote: Add PSTN dial-in capabilities to your Amazon Chime SDK Meeting using SIP media application
Existing customers can continue to use PSTN Audio as they do today.
